main.description: A record indicating the user is enrolled in a Stratos service. Published to the user's PDS during OAuth enrollment for endpoint discovery by AppViews. Multiple enrollment records are supported — one per Stratos service.

service.description: The Stratos service endpoint URL where this user's private data is stored.

boundaries.description: Service-qualified boundaries the user has access to on this Stratos service, each in '{serviceDid}/{domainName}' format.

signingKey.description: The user's public key as a did:key string, used for user-level record signing. For 'stratos' custody this is a P-256 key generated by the Stratos service; for 'pds' custody this is the user's own '#atproto' key from their DID document.

attestation.description: Service attestation vouching for the user's enrollment, boundaries, and signing key.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the enrollment was created.

custody.description: Who hosts and signs this enrollment's repo. 'stratos' is the Stratos-hosted, Stratos-signed repo. 'pds' is the user's own spaces-capable PDS, signing with their own '#atproto' key. Defaults to 'stratos' when absent.

repoHost.description: The repo host endpoint when custody is 'pds'. Absent for 'stratos' custody.

serviceAttestation.description: An attestation signed by the Stratos service key. The signed payload is DAG-CBOR encoded {boundaries, did, signingKey} with sorted keys.

sig.description: Raw signature bytes of the DAG-CBOR encoded attestation payload, signed by the service key.

signingKey.description: The Stratos service's public key as a did:key string, used to verify the attestation signature.
